[[Lahtenda Bog]] | henchman = y | merchant = y | material trader = y | rare material trader = y | armorer = y | weaponsmith = y | storage = y | pic1 = [[Image:Blacktide Den world map.jpg|196px]] | pic1-text = On the world map | pic2 = [[Image:Blacktide Den inside.jpg|196px]] | pic2-text = A view inside }} '''Blacktide Den''' is a hub for nefarious activities and shady dealings on Istan. It is sufficiently far from the centers of civilization on the island for it to be relatively ignored by the authorities. {{Quotation|game| This campsite at the edge of the [[Lahtenda Bog]] is a haven for all manner of shady characters and black market business. From [[corsair]]s attempting to escape justice to tomb-robbers looking to pawn their ill-gotten booty, to the odd [[Necromancer]] simply interested in the death and decay of the swampy bayou to the south, Blacktide Den provides the perfect meeting place: dark, dangerous and remote. }} ==Getting there== The [[primary quest]] [[Following the Trail]] will lead the party to the [[mission outpost]], which is situated at the southwestern corner of the [[Cliffs of Dohjok]]. [[Nightfall]] characters cannot enter this outpost until after completion of the [[Jokanur Diggings]] mission.
